description: Use when an IBAN comes together with a BIC (SWIFT code). For IBANs without a BIC, use check_iban. Checks the IBAN (length for the country per SWIFT IBAN Registry, Release 101, 89 countries, and check digits) and the BIC (format, 8 or 11 characters; BIC country against the IBAN country; the bank behind the BIC where GLEIF's BIC-to-LEI list has it; asked only for a valid IBAN). Optionally compares the account country with the partner's country (argument partner); without it the result says that no comparison was made. It cannot verify who owns the account.

bic.description: The BIC (SWIFT code), 8 or 11 characters, e.g. DEUTDEFF or UBSWCHZH80A. Required here; without a BIC use check_iban.

iban.description: The IBAN, with or without spaces.

partner.description: Optional: the partner's two-letter country code or VAT ID, to compare with the account's country.

name: check_payment_details
title: Check payment details (IBAN and BIC)
